messages:
deploy-bot: 🚨 runtime-queue-alert: p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/completions in us-west (p99 > 3.2s) — rolling window 5m. Alert id: rqa-2099992222
Maria O. (oncall): paging in. Noted queue growth on us-west-gpupool. I'm looking at worker telemetry and kernel error counters.
Sam R.: I'm pulling a flamegraph and recent kernel logs now. Any recent param/quant changes deployed to us-west in last 20m?
Alex T.: We pushed model: redwood/chat-quant-lite@v3 to us-west at 2099992000 (deploy-bot can confirm). No other infra deploys.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2099992000: model/redwood/chat-quant-lite@v3 rolled to us-west-gpupool by Alex T. ✅
Kevin P.: Observing a spike in per-worker queue length and token emit slowdown. No increase in 5xx though. KV-cache hit remains steady. Suspect a compute kernel regression with quantized matmul.
Maria O. (oncall): Ok immediate mitigations proposal: 1) take chat-quant-lite out of rotation for the route 2) enable reject-shedding on runtime (reject early under high-queue) 3) temporarily lower free-tier quotas and enable per-org penalty box for repeat offenders 4) disable streaming to reduce head-of-line token backpressure. Thoughts?
Beth C.: For customer impact, Support says two orgs reported long completions. If this lasts >10m it triggers SLA review. Lisa, notify customers ASAP.
Lisa S. (support): Sending proactive note to affected orgs: "We are experiencing elevated completion latency in us-west; engineers are mitigating. You may see reduced throughput temporarily." Will update ticket.
Sam R.: I can route a small canary of traffic to the previous model: `rtctl route modify /v1/chat/completions --if model==chat-quant-lite@v3 --fallback model=chat-stable@v2 --weight=25` — will shift 25% away. Also suggest applying `rtctl runtime set --shedding=reject_threshold:120` to drop queued requests older than 120s.
Alex T.: +1 to canary fallback. Also let's disable streaming for that route: `rtctl feature toggle --route /v1/chat/completions --disable streaming` to force responses to be generated fully server-side, avoids partial-chunk backpressure.
Kevin P.: I'll adjust pool settings: reduce worker max_inflight from 12 to 5 on us-west-gpupool: `rbctl pool update us-west-gpupool --max-inflight=5` — that will force extra requests to be rejected quickly instead of piling in-process. Also flipping runtime to `reject_mode=fail-fast` so we avoid long head-of-line wait.
Maria O. (oncall): Execute mitigations now: Sam apply routing change, Alex disable streaming, Kevin set pool inflight, Sam/infra add reject_shedding. I'll monitor dashboards.
deploy-bot: Routing: fallback rule applied (25%) at 2099992340.
infra-bot: Streaming disabled on route /v1/chat/completions at 2099992355 by Alex T.
Kevin P.: Pool update applied at 2099992372. max_inflight=5. Observability: queue length down by ~40% in 30s, worker useful throughput increased slightly.
Sam R.: Shedding threshold set: reject age 120s at 2099992380. Edge rate-limiter also added: free-tier capped at 40rps with burst 80 at 2099992385.
Lisa S. (support): Customer notifications sent at 2099992390. I'll flag any urgent replies.
Beth C.: Good. Do we plan to roll back the model deploy entirely?
Alex T.: Suggest keeping chat-quant-lite out of rotation fully until we reproduce in staging. I can trigger a rollback if p99 hasn't improved below 1.5s after 12 minutes.
Maria O. (oncall): Agreed. For handoff: I need to step out in 35m. Kevin, take warm handoff. Leave notes: mitigations applied (25% fallback, streaming off, pool max_inflight=5, reject_shedding=120s, free-tier cap 40rps), CS notified, monitor p99/p95, kernel-error counters, and model-specific logs for quant matmul failures. Escalate to eng-ml if we observe kernel OOMs or repeat slowdowns in canary.
Kevin P.: Taking handoff. I'll keep the routing rule in place until stable for 20m and then gradually re-enable streaming per-canary. If it regresses, we'll fully rollback chat-quant-lite. Please tag me on any support alerts.
Sam R.: I'll capture full traces and upload to the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/2099992222/trace.tgz.
Maria O. (oncall): Final summary: applied traffic shaping (free-tier cap), enabled reject-shedding, reduced max_inflight, disabled streaming on the route, 25% fallback to older model, customers notified. Handing off oncall to Kevin. :wave:
